dbtSql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW primer.main.stg_customer AS
select
    cast(c_custkey as integer) as c_custkey,
    trim(c_name) as c_name,
    trim(c_address) as c_address,
    cast(c_acctbal as decimal(12, 2)) as c_acctbal,
    c_mktsegment,
    c_comment
from "primer"."landing"."customer";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE primer.main.customer_by_segment AS
select
    c_mktsegment,
    count(*) as customer_count,
    sum(c_acctbal) as total_account_balance
from "primer"."main"."stg_customer"
group by c_mktsegment;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE primer.main.customer_balance AS
select
    c_custkey,
    
cast(c_acctbal as decimal(12, 2))
 as account_balance
from "primer"."main"."stg_customer";
